site.signin.continue.button.note: Button of the page the bridge shows before it sends a setup code to a device's page on the home network: it sends the code and goes back to that page.

site.signin.continue.cancel.note: Button of the page the bridge shows before it sends a setup code to a device's page on the home network: it sends nothing and opens the account page instead.

site.signin.continue.heading.text: Continue setting up the device at {host}?
site.signin.continue.heading.note: Heading of the page the bridge shows after a sign-in with Google or Apple that started on a device's own page on the home network, before it sends that page a setup code. {host} is that page's address on the home network (192.168.1.20:8080, otc.local:8080), in bold (<b>): it stays as it is.

site.signin.continue.text.text: Continue sends a setup code for your account to {host}. Only do this if you started setting up a device there yourself: for 15 minutes, whoever has the code can add devices to your account, or move one of your device names to a device of theirs.
site.signin.continue.text.note: Text under site.signin.continue.heading, above the Continue (site.signin.continue.button) and Cancel (site.signin.continue.cancel) buttons. {host} is the address of the device's page on the home network (192.168.1.20:8080): it stays as it is. A setup code is what links a new device to an account; a device name is a device's address on the bridge (name.off-the.cloud). It warns that someone who tricked the person into this page could take over their devices.

site.signin.continue.title.text: Continue the setup — Off The Cloud
site.signin.continue.title.note: Page the bridge shows after a sign-in with Google or Apple that started on a device's own page on the home network (its Settings › Bridge), before it sends that page a setup code: the page title, in the browser tab. Off The Cloud is the product name.

site.signin.error.back.note: Page the bridge shows when a sign-in with Google or Apple can't go on: the button under what went wrong, which opens the account page.

site.signin.error.heading.note: Page the bridge shows when a sign-in with Google or Apple can't go on: the heading, above the sentence saying what went wrong (one of the api.page.* texts).

site.signin.error.title.note: Page the bridge shows when a sign-in with Google or Apple can't go on (a link that isn't valid, a step that expired, the bridge failing): the page title, in the browser tab. Off The Cloud is the product name.
